newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian tourism firm in 6.0 mln dinars bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian tourism firm in 6.0 mln dinars bond issue.

text.p: Tunisian privately-owned firm Ulysse on Wednesday launched a six million dinars seven-year bond issue at a 9.5 percent coupon rate.
The company says subscriptions for 60,000 bonds at 100 dinars each will be opened to the public on February 24 and closed on March 3.
It said the issue was guaranteed by Amen Bank, Arab Tunisian Bank, Banque Nationale Agricole and Union Internationale de Banques.
Payment of interests would start on March 3, 1998, and yearly reimbursment of capital on March 3, 2000, Ulysse says. ($=1.07 dinar)
